::: {.why}
This is the deliverable the rest of the year refers back to, and its value is entirely in being computed once, in advance, before any result you care about exists.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the backtested Sharpe ratio your own research process must exceed before the result is evidence of anything, and show the calculation.
- Say what would make that number change, and by how much.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Write qlib/noise.py: given a trial count, a sample length and a strategy correlation assumption, return the required Sharpe threshold, using your day 51 maximum-of-nulls simulation rather than a closed form. Have it also return the threshold under the pessimistic and optimistic trial counts, so the answer is a range and not a point.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Compute your own number and write it into reports/milestone-02-noise-floor.md as a single sentence you will be held to: at your expected trial count and sample length, a backtested Sharpe below this value is not evidence. Then state the two things that would move it, which are the trial count and the correlation among the variants you try.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
qlib/noise.py fixes the evidence threshold for the whole year. Every later milestone reports its results against this number, which was computed before any of those results existed, and that ordering is what makes it a threshold rather than a rationalisation.
:::

## Resources

- [Bailey & López de Prado (2014) — The Deflated Sharpe Ratio](https://www.davidhbailey.com/dhbpapers/deflated-sharpe.pdf) [paper]{.res-kind}
- [Bailey, Borwein, López de Prado & Zhu (2017) — The Probability of Backtest Overfitting](https://escholarship.org/content/qt4w1110bb/qt4w1110bb.pdf) [paper]{.res-kind}

## Deliverable

::: {.deliverable}
qlib/noise.py returning a Sharpe threshold, and the one-sentence commitment in the milestone report with the number in it.
:::

## Checkpoint

::: {.checkpoint}
State your noise floor and the two assumptions behind it. Then say what it becomes if you try five times as many variants.
:::
